purpose: Shows a stored reference to another record as that record's name, a button that opens it, with the stored address on a quiet second line.
namedChanges: `useResolvedRefLabel(parsed, vaultId)` is `useRefLabel(parsed, vaultId)`, the hook read from the new `RefLabelContext` (`useContext`) and called in the same place; with no provider it throws. `UseRefLabel` and `RefLabelContext` are new exports. `entityRefFromFact` is imported from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-entity-ref`.

library.title: Record reference shown by name
library.note: Shows a stored link as the record's name; includes GilbApp's refDisplayName (not entity-ref's).
